packageRules.description: gha-runner-scale-set must match the ARC controller version (arc-controller-k3s, pinned in its ArgoCD app, which Renovate can't see), and the chart tgz is vendored under charts/, so a bare Chart.yaml bump is a no-op that only desyncs Chart.lock. Upgrade controller and scale sets together by hand.

ToolHive charts are vendored under charts/ (a bare Chart.yaml bump is a no-op that desyncs Chart.lock), and the CRDs chart must move in lockstep with the operator chart. Upgrade both by hand: see infrastructure_tooling/toolhive_mcp/README.md.

The tailscale-operator chart is vendored under charts/ (a bare Chart.yaml bump is a no-op that desyncs Chart.lock), and it is applied to docker-compose-03 by hand, not by Argo CD. Upgrade by hand: see the Tailscale Operator section of README.md.
Charts are vendored under charts/: have Renovate run helm dependency update so a chart bump commits the new tgz too (otherwise the old one keeps rendering).

Everything in the homelab agents image (Python lock and both Chainguard digests, which must move together) rebuilds the same :main image the CronJobs run: one PR, one rebuild. requirements.txt is a uv pip compile lock that Renovate edits pin by pin (its pip-compile manager can't take --python-platform), so if the build fails, re-run the uv pip compile command in its header on the PR branch.
